name: labs/bamresearch__mapz_at_bam
title: IKA RCT digital 5 hotplate and magnetic stirrer (Minerva RCTDigital5)
intro: IKA RCT digital 5 hotplate and magnetic stirrer (Minerva RCTDigital5), adapted from bamresearch/mapz_at_bam. It reads `device_name`, `external_temperature`, `hotplate_temperature`, `stirring_speed` and 2 more; sets `temperature_setpoint` and `stirring_speed_setpoint`; runs `heat_to`, `start_stirring` and `stop_hotplate`. `heat_to`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
